changelog:
SMOOTH — Time commands, smart screensaver exit, touch pad polish, finished speaking detection.

Time: "ten seconds tomorrow" countdown, "wake me at seven tomorrow" alarm, "remind me at two" reminder. Length and clock face in one sentence, both done. "Settings" opens Ava settings, "set an alarm" sets alarm, house alarm needs named device. Five max, named "task event (alarm/reminder)" in HA, -1 from second onward. Date/time bidirectional HA sync. Empty slots hidden, persist after reboot. "How many minutes left" reads countdown. Stop while ringing stops countdown/alarm/reminder.

House queries: "how many lights on" counts from index, speaks readable, skips unreadable. "Is live dashboard on" reads/flips switches. Mod store catalog/install status by text, install/turn off/uninstall by name. Model draft stays internal, spoken sentence is final.

Smart Screensaver Exit: notification sits on top of screensaver, on by default. Off: notification dismisses screensaver, idle timer restarts. Same scene twice: dropdown returns to idle after show. Boot scene cache: shows last copy, retries fetch. Round mic stays with notification/floating app. Path: Settings → Screensaver → Behavior & wake. Thanks @popy2k14 #223 #226 #229.

Dream Clock lock: theme swipes fold away, timer stays. Full-bleed/flip in settings. Taller timer buttons, haptic, larger pause, dimmed clock behind.

Touch pad: three-finger down collapses, same gesture reopens. Keyboard keys recorded in automation, playback follows pace. Small pad: slots 1-5 scroll sideways. Trash travels across on delete. Voice card scroll stops on finger press.

Pages/layers: browser row in shade = sidebar = HA switch. Hidden/Exit/Reload distinct. Pull-to-refresh inside page. Settings liquid glass eases blurred to clear. Back stays top layer. Layers follow Ava orientation. Dream Clock above browser. Remote focus ring transparent with sidebar open, shows on movement.

Finished speaking detection: Aggressive 0.25s, Default 0.7s, Relaxed 1.25s. Syncs with HA "Finished speaking detection on this satellite." Hidden until HA connected. Path: Settings → Voice Config → Speech-to-text → STT listening engine.

Android 5/6 UnicodeScript crash fixed, character judgment替代. Thanks @oriabkov #219 ZX-WA1012T.

Fixes: Echo Show 8 brightness 0=off, 1=dim @popy2k14 #228. Wake ripple RuntimeShader software canvas @scenix222 #230 Galaxy S21. Browser Display Android 5.1.1 getRootWindowInsets @oriabkov #219. Voice-message back control. Dynamic captions larger on small screens.
